newsitem.title: USA: US stocks to open mixed ahead of durable goods.
newsitem.headline: US stocks to open mixed ahead of durable goods.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open slightly down on Thursday, but the release of August orders for durable goods and weekly jobless claims could boost the market's confidence.

"We're indicated lower but I think it will reverse by the opening if the (data) come in weak, which would support a higher bond market," said Westafalia Investments director of research Peter Cardillo.
Analysts expects a drop of 0.1 percent in August durable goods orders, due at 1230 GMT.
